时笙挑拨离间完，立即就不说话了，任由那些人去吵。

常新的人都去帮常新了，时笙自然就自由了。

“老大，你好厉害……”清玉默默的时笙点了个赞。

“外面的丧尸真的是ZF弄出来的吗？天……想想就觉得好恐怖，老大，给我来点吃的，我要增肥压压惊。”小胖肥呼呼的手伸到时笙面前。

“胖子，你这后面一句才是重点吧！”看透某人的林风立即拆台，“不过，这里看起来确实很诡异……”

时笙把背包扔给小胖，里面没有装东西，只装着白虎。

“老大，我们不会出不去了吧？”林风又开始杞人忧天。

“有老大在，肯定能出去。”清玉盲目的崇拜，“你就安心吧，小胖，你一个人吃也不怕撑死，给老大拿过来啊！！”

林风想想也是，好像还没老大做不到的事。

显然他们忘了，在他们相遇的时候，他们无所不能的老大，连个汽油都不会抽。

时笙没吃多少东西，就喝了一瓶奶。

趁着那边的人吵得不可开交的时候，时笙将实验室转了一圈。

这里的东西不多，但是并不凌乱，证明撤离的时候这些人并不惊慌。

时笙停在一块黑板前，上面贴着几张A4纸，她正要伸手去拿，一双手抢先了一步。

时笙顺着手看去，手的主人正是宋拾。

“顾南，你这么挑拨他们有意思吗？”宋拾的话冷冰冰的。

“有啊。”时笙笑着点头，“用事实证明，他们有多蠢。”

宋拾：“……”这女人是有反社倾向吧？

“阿拾……表妹，你，你怎么也在这里？”戚明雪从远处走过来，一副才看到时笙的惊讶模样。

随后又委屈难过的垂下头，好像时笙欺负她似的。

阿拾……老子还阿屎呢！

时笙翻了个白眼，“别乱叫啊，想抱我大腿，你也得先排队的。”

“噗——”正好过来的清玉听到这话，很不厚道的笑了。

讲真，他越来越觉得自家老大中二病得不轻。

戚明雪脸色瞬间难看，却还是故作倔强的道：“表妹，就算你不喜欢我，也不用这么羞辱我。”

“我哪里羞辱你了？你听到了吗？”

清玉配合的摇头，他家老大不喜欢这个妹纸……虽然他觉得这妹纸长得挺好看的。

可是老大不喜欢，他也不能喜欢。

就是这么不讲道理！！

“表妹，你……”

After Shi Sheng finished stirring up trouble, he immediately stopped talking and allowed those people to argue.

Everyone in Chang Xin went to help Chang Xin, and Shi Sheng was naturally free.

"Boss, you are so awesome..." Qing Yu silently gave Shi Sheng a thumbs up.

"Are the zombies outside really caused by the government? Oh my god...it makes me feel so scary just thinking about it. Boss, give me something to eat. I want to gain weight and calm down my fear." The chubby little man stretched out his hand in front of Shi Sheng.

"Fat man, the last sentence of yours is the key point!" Lin Feng, who had seen through someone, immediately dismissed the situation, "However, this place does look weird..."

Shi Sheng threw the backpack to Xiaopang. There was nothing in it, only Bai Hu.

"Boss, are we unable to get out?" Lin Feng began to worry again.

"With the boss here, I will definitely be able to go out." Qing Yu worshiped blindly, "Don't worry, little fat, you are not afraid of dying by eating alone, bring it to the boss!!"

When Lin Feng thought about it, there seemed to be nothing that the boss couldn't do.

Apparently they forgot that when they met, their all-powerful boss couldn't even pump a gas.

Shi Sheng didn't eat much and drank a bottle of milk.

While the people there were noisy, Shi Sheng walked around the laboratory.

There are not many things here, but they are not messy, which proves that these people did not panic when evacuating.

Shi Sheng stopped in front of a blackboard with several A4 papers taped on it. She was about to reach out for it when a pair of hands took the lead.

Shi Sheng looked along the hand and saw that the owner of the hand was none other than Song Shi.

"Gu Nan, are you interested in provoking them like this?" Song Shi's words were cold.

"Yes." Shi Sheng smiled and nodded, "Use facts to prove how stupid they are."

Song Shi: "..." Does this woman have anti-social tendencies?

"Ah Shi...Cousin, you, why are you here?" Qi Mingxue walked over from a distance, looking surprised as if she had just seen Shi Sheng.

Then she lowered her head sadly, as if Shi Sheng had bullied her.

Ah Shi... I'm still a shit!

Shi Sheng rolled his eyes, "Don't scream. If you want to hug my thigh, you have to queue up first."

"Pfft--" Qingyu, who happened to come over, heard this and smiled unkindly.

To be honest, he felt more and more that his boss, Zhong Er, was seriously ill.

Qi Mingxue's face turned ugly for a moment, but she still pretended to be stubborn and said: "Cousin, even if you don't like me, there is no need to humiliate me like this."

"Where did I humiliate you? Did you hear me?"

Qingyu shook his head in cooperation. His boss didn't like this girl... although he thought she was pretty.

But the boss doesn't like it, and he can't like it either.

It's just so unreasonable!!

"Cousin, you..."
